chennai-2015.notes: The twelve CodeChef problem pages (CHN01-CHN12) do not name the contest; the link to Chennai 2015 rests on the 2016 Wayback copies of the CodeChef 'Chennai Onsite Mirror/Replay Contest 2015' pages, which list CHN01-CHN12 and also CHN15. No letters A-L are printed on the problem pages.
